avg_invoice.question: Divide total invoice revenue by the number of months. Return that mean monthly revenue, not the revenue of one invoice.
avg_invoice.reference:
import sqlite3, os, pandas as pd
conn = sqlite3.connect("chinook.sqlite")
q1 = """
SELECT t.Name AS track, al.Title AS album, ar.Name AS artist,
       ROUND(SUM(il.Quantity*il.UnitPrice),2) AS revenue
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId=il.TrackId
JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId=t.AlbumId
JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId=al.ArtistId
GROUP BY t.TrackId ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5
"""

import sqlite3 as _sq3
_c2 = _sq3.connect("chinook.sqlite")
_tot = pd.read_sql("SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total),2) AS t FROM Invoice", _c2).iloc[0, 0]
avg = round(_tot / 60, 2)
_c2.close()

cases.expect: The result is the mean of the monthly totals, not the grand total.

rock_revenue.question: Add only the revenue from tracks in the Rock genre. Return that Rock revenue amount, not Rock's share of all revenue.
rock_revenue.reference:
q2 = """
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM Customer c
LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId=c.CustomerId
WHERE i.InvoiceId IS NULL
"""

import sqlite3 as _sq3
_c2 = _sq3.connect("chinook.sqlite")
_rk = pd.read_sql("SELECT ROUND(SUM(il.Quantity*il.UnitPrice),2) AS r FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId=il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId=t.GenreId WHERE g.Name='Rock'", _c2).iloc[0, 0]
_c2.close()
rock_revenue = _rk

cases.input: Rock amounts of 10 and 15, plus jazz of 50.
cases.expect: The result is Rock revenue only, 25, not the Rock share.

mean_spend.question: Divide total invoice revenue by the number of customers. Return that mean spend per customer, not the mean of single invoice lines.
mean_spend.reference:
total = pd.read_sql("SELECT SUM(Total) AS t FROM Invoice", conn).iloc[0, 0]
customers = pd.read_sql("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM Customer", conn).iloc[0, 0]
mean_spend = total / customers

cases.input: Three customers spent 10, 20, and 30 in total.
cases.expect: The result is the mean spend per customer, not per invoice line.
The mean equals that customer's spend.
